purpose: Teach: トレーディング/ファクト/定款/後部/圧巻/称する/用法/求職

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、不正トレーディングの捜査を継続されてますね
lines.en: The police are continuing their investigation into illegal trading, aren't they?
lines.style: Steady, observational tone. Light respect embedded in the phrasing. Measured pace, like noting something clearly without pressing. Slight upward lift at the end—conversational acknowledgment rather than interrogation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、捜査結果はファクトに基づきますね
lines.en: The investigation results are based on facts, of course.
lines.style: Calm, matter-of-fact delivery. Emphasis lands gently on 「facts」—not defensive, just stating what's reliable. Even pace, grounded. A nod to professional integrity.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、防犯団体の定款を確認されますね
lines.en: They do review the regulations of the crime prevention organization.
lines.style: Straightforward, slightly formal. Tone suggests mild admiration for thoroughness without overstatement. Steady breath. The voice of someone noting competence with a small, warm approval.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、車両の後部の証拠も丁寧に採取されますね
lines.en: They're meticulous about collecting evidence from vehicle scenes, aren't they?
lines.style: Warm noticing. Soft emphasis on 「meticulous」—genuine recognition. Slower pace, like watching careful work and being impressed by it. Slight trailing appreciation at the end.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、市民との連携訓練が圧巻でしたね
lines.en: The joint training exercises with citizens were quite remarkable.
lines.style: Genuine warmth with a touch of admiration. Slight breathiness—this impressed him. Pace relaxes slightly, like he's still registering how well it went. Quiet but sincere.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、防犯活動を「セーフタウン作戦」と称する事にされましたね
lines.en: They've named their crime prevention initiative the 'Safe Town Operation,' haven't they?
lines.style: Light, almost appreciative tone. Small smile in the voice at the naming choice. Even pace. The slight formality of the title is met with warmth rather than irony.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、薬物の用法に偽装した犯罪を捜査されますね
lines.en: They're investigating crimes disguised as drug-related offenses.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact shift. Focused, serious. The complexity of the investigation lands with quiet weight. Steady breathing, no flourish. Recognition that this requires careful distinction.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、求職活動詐欺の捜査もご対応ですね
lines.en: They're also handling investigations into employment fraud, I see.
lines.style: Acknowledgment with a small, respectful nod in the voice. Slightly warmer than the previous line. Pace evens out. The recognition that they handle multiple fronts—quietly competent.
